title: Freddie's first jobs: Joe Petit, Hannan's Saloon, first cornet
summary: Freddie played violin under Teton (Adolf Alexander) and with Joe Petit, got his first cornet from their father, and played his first cornet job at Lake Lucien Pavilion; Louis took over his job at the jewelry store.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Well, he's his father. He lives on Dernan, New Orleans. And then my brother came to my father and mother and told him that he said he had a man playing. He said then he started playing with Joe Petit. But his first job was in the district on Murray Street at Hannan's Saloon, Murray and Alvabelle. And before he started playing music, he was working in Michalis' juror store when he was a little bit of a kid on Rylan Beaville. Then he started going with Joe Petit. He was a travel player, of course. He was a travel player.
Yes, I knew him. He was a travel player.

He was a travel player. Yes. And, but nevertheless, he used to, after he quit the job, well, I'd taken his job on Rylan and Beaville at Mr. Michel. It's a juror store. And when he left from there, he started playing. My daddy bought him a little brass cornet. Then he started learning that and then he went and played with Joe Petit. That's his first job with cornet out there. After he left Bally, he said that he told my mother and father that he could not be heard and he wanted to get a cornet. So he takes my dad and my mother, brought him a cornet and he started fooling around with him. And then our dog Alexander, he used to take and play cornet while he showed him. And he used to play with Valtou, old violin player. He was playing violin at that time. And what happened when he started playing? The first job it was at the Lake Lucian Pavilion. That's the first job he played on cornet. Well, they've taken liking to him. So ever since that, he started fooling with cornet and playing cornet with the band.
